en: \bBuck: Let's not waste time! Let's do this!
\bBuck: Huh, what?
\rMarley: Don't be mean by leaving me behind. Take me with you.
\rMarley: I... won't lose...!
\rMarley: I'm getting to dislike you a little.
\bEmmet: Follow the rules, and our tracks go on forever!
\bEmmet: Announcement! Full speed ahead!
\bEmmet: See you next stop!
\bIngo: Safety protocol's in place, this journey's only just begun!
\bIngo: Eh-eh-hem. All aboooard!
\bIngo: Door's closing!
\bNoland: Gather up all the knowledge you've got, and show them what we can do!
\bNoland: I like how you think.
\bNoland: Hey, hey.
\rGreta: Are you sure you're up with me?
\rGreta: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion for battle!
\rGreta: Oh, come on!
\bTucker: Ahahah! Do you hear it? They're all itching to see our partnership!
\bTucker: Embrace the brilliant glow!
\bTucker: Oh well!
\rLucy: I've trampled flowers and braved storms to get to where I am today.
\rLucy: Your luck... I hope you didn't use it all up.
\rLucy: Disappear already...
\bSpenser: The bond you share with your Pokémon! Prove it!
\bSpenser: Your Pokémon's eyes are truly clear and unclouded.
\bSpenser: Hahahaha!!
\rAnabel: Let me see your talent in its entirety.
\rAnabel: Looks like we have a job to do.
\rAnabel: Next time!
\bBrandon: You coming here means you have that much confidence in yourself, am I right?
\bBrandon: Hahahah! This should be exciting!
\bBrandon: Well well...
\bPalmer: We'll have to give them our best effort, as a way of respect!
\bPalmer: Bravo! I look forward to this on a great deal.
\bPalmer: No problem!
\rDahlia: No need to worry. Let chance do what it does.
\rDahlia: Are you incredible because you are so lucky?
\rDahlia: Swayed by luck.
\bThorton: Just so you know, pleasure to meet me.
\bThorton: According to my data, battling with me is the optimal choice.
\bThorton: Calculated.
\bDarach: Let me assure you, you won't be shortchanged with me.
\bDarach: Allow me to accompany you.
\bDarach: Please excuse me.
\rArgenta: I believe I am the most daunting pick here.
\rArgenta: Oh. You made a good pick.
\rArgenta: Fun times seem to last only a moment.
\bMilo: We're not going to be done in that easy! We're tough as weeds!
\bMilo: All right. Let's get going!
\bMilo: All right, then. See you!
\rNessa: I'll show you why they call me the raging wave!
\rNessa: Hope you're ready to make some waves!
\rNessa: Bye! See you soon.
\bKabu: Should you need my help, please do not hesitate to ask. I'll turn up the heat for you!
\bKabu: I will expend my strength while learning from your example.
\bKabu: See you again.
\rBea: I'll use karate along with my Pokémon's moves!
\rBea: Allow me to fight by your side.
\rBea: Farewell.
\bAllister: There are things that... only I can see. D-do you... wanna know about them?
\bAllister: We can fight... together!
\bAllister: G-g'bye!
\rOpal: You could use some more pink, child.
\rOpal: Good. Let me show you the power of pink, child.
\rOpal: On you go, child.
\bGordie: If we team up, our battles are bound to get the crowd going!
\bGordie: We're a monolith of power!
\bGordie: Later!
\rMelony: I think you'll find my battle style is quite severe.
\rMelony: Very well, I will lend you my help.
\rMelony: See you later.
\bAvery: With my prodigious psychic powers, the idea that anyone should ever be able to defeat us is positively unimaginable!
\bAvery: Allow me to assist you - with elegance!
\bAvery: A good day to you, then.
\rKlara: This seems like a great chance to show off just how toxic we can be!
\rKlara: Choosing me, eh? You really know what you're doing!
\rKlara: Buh-bye!
\bPiers: Get ready for a mosh pit with me and my partner!
\bPiers: Now, time to rock!
\bPiers: Cheers.
